{{Top}}
[[File:Fruits.png|thumb|250px|Fruit being served at the [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] lake retreat.]]
A '''fruit''' was the sweet and fleshy product of a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] or other [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that contained [[Seed/Legends|seed]]. It came in different sizes, shapes, and [[Color/Legends|colors]] and was usually edible, but not always. Types of fruit included [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]], [[Shuura/Legends|shuura]],<ref name="AotCBook">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> [[Meiloorun/Legends|meiloorun]]<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> and [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]]. Fruit could be used in [[Salad/Legends|salads]]<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> and [[Cake/Legends|cakes]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> and could be used to make [[Fruit juice/Legends|fruit juice]].<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref> ''Candied fruit'' was another variant.<ref name="The Last Jedi novel">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
